imputation.method: Within-patient forward fill (ffill) + Set A Training Median fallback
imputation.max_fill_duration: Unlimited within ICU stay; initial unobserved values filled with Set A training medians

causal_normalization.temporal_safety: Strict expanding window tau <= t. Future information (tau > t) is zero-masked.
causal_normalization.iqr_zero_fallback: When IQR == 0, denominator equals epsilon (1e-5), stabilizing z_{i,t,k} to 0.0.
causal_normalization.epsilon_sensitivity_status: STATUS: NOT ESTABLISHED (Epsilon fixed at 1e-5 in frozen pipeline specification)

unit_normalization_audit.conversion: Fahrenheit converted to Celsius where Temp > 45
